question: Which café are available within 40 kilometers along the corridor from the St. Regis San Francisco, San Francisco, CA to Joyce Gordon Gallery, Oakland, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.401381 37.786057)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.270127 37.80409)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.401381 37.786057)',4326)::geography, 40000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.401381 37.786057)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
